artboards.title: Proposed — the menu on the card
The item, the word, the undo

annotations.text:
Issue #715

"give me a way to remove someone from the prayer list in dropdown so that I don't have to go all the way to the top to choose people and remove name"

Reported from /prayer at 1107x662.
Try it: the menu is open on Daniel's card. Choose Remove from prayer list — the card leaves, Mei rises, and Undo puts him back.

#714 is the other half of this: "Archived" already names a prayer's mark on this same page, so "Archive from Prayer List" reads as if it acts on the prayers. The board on the right settles the wording.
The measurements are added up from the stylesheets at the reported viewport, not eyeballed from a screenshot — text metrics move them a few px either way.
